verdict.rationale: Phaser documents built-in Arcade Physics that works out of the box, letting sprites use velocity, acceleration and gravity, and its editor exposes adjustable physics bodies. The docs themselves say it is lightweight with limitations, handling only rectangles and circles, so true rigid-body simulation is not shown. Missing for 10: evidence of full rigid-body dynamics (rotation, arbitrary polygon shapes), explicit collision-detection/response documentation, raycast support, and independent hands-on corroboration of physics behavior.
